column1: # Commit trailers observed in real commits on GitHub, with the count seen in the
# sample they came from and the date of that observation.
# This file is the ONLY thing detection patterns may be tested against. Fixtures
# built from the ruleset assert that our list matches our list, which cannot
# fail: that is how five channels shipped a confident zero across the whole
# roster while their tests stayed green.
# tool          the tool a rule must attribute this to
# NOT-<tool>    observed and must NOT match: a human or an address we decline
# observed_at   when it was sampled; a stale-only match is a rule that has quietly stopped working
# n_seen        occurrences in that sample, so a rule matching only rare shapes is visible as such
# Regenerate with scripts/survey-trailers.R. Do not hand-add a string nobody has seen.
